notes: Eval layer on base profiles. ortg_full is a Dean Oliver / Basketball-Reference style ORtg in points form (see player_eval.py _oliver_ortg), box-score only; no play-by-play, no opponent adjustment on ortg_full itself. ortg_simple is the base simplified ORtg. ratings.rpr is RPR v1.1 (ORtg shrunk toward the league average, K = 200 possessions used, and opponent-adjusted; old value kept as rpr_v1, value delivered as rpr_value = RPR v1.1 * GP / 82). The RPR component breakdown sums to RPR v1.1. Trending window is the last 7 days of games in the data.
